{{Quote|This is Darth Malgus of the Expeditionary Fleet. I bring greetings from the Veragi Sector.|Darth Malgus|<ref name="TOR:CtA">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Call to Arms|the ''White Nova''}}</ref>}}
The '''Veragi sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] adjacent to the [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]]. It surrounded and included the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]].

==History==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the Gree Enclave had became a subsector of the Veragi sector and was ruled by its own [[Moff/Legends|Moff]].<ref name="EAOC" />

In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the Veragi sector was one of the first sectors [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="TEA" />
